assessment.provenance: Actual private Next/compiler and untouched-exporter bytes from base 26cdafc520fbbf69af216f460bb0dc9fed867427 and a declared dirty working-preview. Temporary technical admission inside an isolated clone served inspection only and supplies no editorial acceptance.
assessment.reconstruction: Exact rollback of B20/B22 MDX bytes (oldFileShas) and raw records (5 prior claims + 9 sources + 10 readings + 8 works + added records) recovers the exact 65aafe25 predecessor pin (ff59fb32...) before #133 -> #131 -> ... -> older qualifiers, verifying all 75 transitions and 497 cross-generation consumers.
assessment.guards: Two-round independent adversarial publication-engineering security audit (d27d00d5) verified closed config/unit/history key allowlists (blocking layouts, partIntroduction, migrations, ordinaryOverrides), 18-carrier SHA-256 verification, 83/83 BigInt rational closure and prose bindings, lib/reader-book.ts getCitationLabel route coverage, ReaderTable index/id guards, assertCleanReaderProse hygiene, all 5 inline display:block correction notices, and CSS zero-drift (be180e5d...), concluding unconditional PASS (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR).
assessment.actual: Comparison of all 88 article projections identifies the exact changed articles and changed public artifacts across B20/B22 web & /print, neighbor pagination, and catalog/research projections. All 468 manifest payloads and 40 case downloads verified.
assessment.browser: Passed 40 responsive viewport/theme checks across B20/B22 web & /print × 5 widths (390–2560px) × light/dark (including 2 responsive MDX tables on B22, zero overflow), no-script keyboard Enter suites across all 14 dated history controls, dual-view prose checks, Meta+k search, and @media print verification confirming all 5 inline display:block corrections remain visible while all <details> disclosures hide cleanly.
assessment.limits: Clean production build (dirty:false), source PR/CI/merge, live EdgeOne byte/guard qualification and exact root submodule integration remain required after this scoped acceptance.
